books.author: George Orwell
books.short_description: A dystopian novel about surveillance, totalitarianism, and the struggle for individual freedom.
books.long_description: George Orwell's 1984 follows Winston Smith, a man living under the control of an authoritarian government that monitors its citizens and manipulates information. The novel explores surveillance, propaganda, censorship, language, truth, and individual freedom.

books.name: The Hobbit
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.short_description: A fantasy adventure following Bilbo Baggins on an unexpected journey.
books.long_description: The Hobbit follows Bilbo Baggins, a quiet hobbit whose life changes when he joins thirteen dwarves and the wizard Gandalf on a quest to reclaim their homeland and treasure from the dragon Smaug. Along the way, Bilbo encounters trolls, goblins, elves, and a mysterious ring.

books.name: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.short_description: A practical guide to building better habits through small, consistent improvements.
books.long_description: Atomic Habits explains how tiny changes in behavior can produce significant results over time. James Clear presents practical strategies for creating good habits, breaking bad ones, designing supportive environments, and making continuous improvement part of everyday life.

books.name: The Alchemist
books.author: Paulo Coelho
books.short_description: A philosophical adventure about following dreams and discovering one's purpose.
books.long_description: The Alchemist tells the story of Santiago, a young shepherd who travels from Spain toward the Egyptian pyramids after dreaming about a hidden treasure. During his journey, he meets people who teach him about dreams, courage, love, opportunity, and discovering his personal path.

books.name: Rich Dad Poor Dad
books.author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
books.short_description: A personal finance book about money, investing, assets, and financial education.
books.long_description: Rich Dad Poor Dad presents financial lessons based on the author's experiences with two father figures who had very different approaches to money. The book discusses financial education, assets, liabilities, investing, entrepreneurship, and developing a different perspective toward wealth.

books.name: The Psychology of Money
books.author: Morgan Housel
books.short_description: An exploration of how psychology and behavior influence financial decisions.
books.long_description: The Psychology of Money examines how people think about wealth, saving, investing, risk, and financial decisions. Morgan Housel uses stories and behavioral insights to explain why financial success often depends as much on behavior and patience as it does on knowledge.

books.name: Deep Work
books.author: Cal Newport
books.short_description: A guide to focused work and developing concentration in a distracted world.
books.long_description: Deep Work argues that the ability to concentrate without distraction is increasingly valuable. Cal Newport explains how focused work can improve productivity and provides strategies for reducing distractions, building concentration, and creating routines that support meaningful work.

books.name: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.author: Harper Lee
books.short_description: A coming-of-age novel exploring justice, racism, empathy, and morality.
books.long_description: Set in the American South during the 1930s, To Kill a Mockingbird is narrated by Scout Finch as she grows up and observes her community. The story explores racial injustice, moral courage, compassion, childhood, and the importance of understanding other people's perspectives.

books.name: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.short_description: A classic romance exploring love, marriage, social class, and first impressions.
books.long_description: Pride and Prejudice follows Elizabeth Bennet as she navigates family expectations, social conventions, and her complicated relationship with the wealthy Mr. Darcy. Jane Austen explores love, marriage, reputation, class, pride, and the consequences of judging others too quickly.

books.name: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
books.author: J.K. Rowling
books.short_description: The first Harry Potter adventure at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
books.long_description: Harry Potter discovers that he is a wizard and begins his education at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. There he makes close friends, learns about the magical world, and becomes involved in a mystery connected to a powerful object and his own past.
